whatTheyDo.value: NKT provides power cable solutions, including low-, medium- and high-voltage cable systems and accessories.
NKT provides high-voltage onshore and offshore cable systems, including design, manufacturing and installation services.
NKT also provides cable accessories and lifecycle services such as repair, maintenance and operations support.

technologies.value: High-voltage AC and DC onshore cable systems.

Dynamic offshore cables designed to withstand continuous movement and fatigue.
Cable joints, connectors and terminations for high- and medium-voltage applications.
